# gitmoap_templates (Data Source)

List file templates. The templates a new file can start from — licences, `.gitignore` files, and a repository's paperwork: a changelog, a contributing guide, a code of conduct, a security policy and a service catalog. Without `kind`, every template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_templates" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Only templates of this kind

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `default_path` (String) Where the file usually goes: `LICENSE`, `.gitignore`, `.gitmoap/catalog.yaml`.
- `fields` (Attributes List) The values the content asks for, in the order it first asks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--fields))
- `key` (String) Unique within its kind: `mit`, `rust`, `default`.
- `kind` (String) What a template is for.
- `name` (String)
- `spdx_id` (String) A licence's SPDX identifier.
- `summary` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.fields`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) What to call it next to the input that fills it in.
- `name` (String) The placeholder's name — `year` stands for `{{year}}`.
